intro: Bladeleaf the Elder is a Lunar Festival encounter in the night elf settlement of Dolanaar. Standing beneath a shaft of celestial moonlight, Elder Bladeleaf greets travelers celebrating their ancestors and guides seekers onward across the boughs of Teldrassil. Paying respects to this honored spirit offers wisdom on reading the starry skies and honors the heritage of the night elves.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, friend. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?
